content.intro: Learn secure cookies and https through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Secure Cookies and HTTPS matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines secure cookies and https as part of security and privacy. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
content_blocks.text: The source syllabus for this lesson names: Secure cookies; HTTP Strict Transport Security; TLS termination; HTTPS redirects; Proxy configuration and trustworthy forwarded headers. Keep these distinct concepts together: know what each item does, when it applies, and what assumption must be verified in your project.

items.title: Secure cookies
items.text: For Secure cookies, identify the Django component responsible, the inputs and outputs it owns, and the boundary conditions that matter. items.title: HTTP Strict Transport Security
items.text: HTTP Strict Transport Security is a server-side responsibility where applicable. Define who may perform the action and on which object, validate untrusted input, test denied cases, and document sensitive-data handling.

items.title: TLS termination
items.text: For TLS termination, identify the Django component responsible, the inputs and outputs it owns, and the boundary conditions that matter. Use the accompanying example as a starting point, verify it with the official versioned documentation, and record one test demonstrating expected behavior.

items.title: HTTPS redirects
items.text: Redirect by a named route or a validated destination. Never build an open redirect from an untrusted query parameter; distinguish temporary from permanent redirects.

items.title: Proxy configuration and trustworthy forwarded headers
items.text: Configuration for Proxy configuration and trustworthy forwarded headers should be explicit, environment-aware, and validated before serving requests. Record defaults and deploy-specific values, keep secrets outside committed content, and test the setting that changes behavior.
